files.from: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/static/public/697/predict+students+dropout+and+academic+success.zip → data.csv (byte for byte: a UTF-8 byte-order mark, semicolons, CRLF kept), UCI's own download
files.dataset: Predict Students' Dropout and Academic Success (UCI id 697, DOI 10.24432/C5MC89): 4,424 students of a Portuguese higher-education institution, 36 columns known at enrolment and at the end of the first two semesters, target Dropout / Enrolled / Graduate at the end of the course's normal duration
files.licence: CC BY 4.0, as the UCI page states
files.cite: V. Realinho, M. Vieira Martins, J. Machado and L. Baptista. Predict Students' Dropout and Academic Success [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository (2021), https://doi.org/10.24432/C5MC89
files.note: dropped out = 1; enrolled and graduated = 0. Codes for course, application mode, nationality, qualifications and occupations are numbers in the file; their meanings are UCI's own variable table, kept verbatim in data/fresh6-codebook.json
